entries.title: Job 3:1
segments: ¶After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.

entries.title: Job 3:2
segments: And Job spake, and said, {spake: Heb. answered}

entries.title: Job 3:3
segments: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night [in which] it was said, There is a man child conceived.

entries.title: Job 3:4
segments: Let that day be darkness; let not God regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.

entries.title: Job 3:5
segments: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it. {stain: or, challenge} {let the...: or, let them terrify it, as those who have a bitter day}

entries.title: Job 3:6
segments: As [for] that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months. {let it not be...: or, let it not rejoice among the days}

entries.title: Job 3:7
segments: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice come therein.

entries.title: Job 3:8
segments: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise up their mourning. {their...: or, leviathan}

entries.title: Job 3:9
segments: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but [have] none; neither let it see the dawning of the day: {the dawning...: Heb. the eyelids of the morning}

entries.title: Job 3:10
segments: Because it shut not up the doors of my [mother's] womb, nor hid sorrow from mine eyes.

entries.title: Job 3:11
segments: ¶Why died I not from the womb? [why] did I [not] give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?

words.text: ? [why] did I [not] give up the ghost

entries.title: Job 3:12
segments: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?

entries.title: Job 3:13
segments: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,

words.text: For now should I have lain still
: then had I been at rest

entries.title: Job 3:14
segments: With kings and counsellors of the earth, which built desolate places for themselves;

entries.title: Job 3:15
segments: Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:

entries.title: Job 3:16
segments: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants [which] never saw light.

words.text: I had not been; as infants

entries.title: Job 3:17
segments: There the wicked cease [from] troubling; and there the weary be at rest. {weary: Heb. wearied in strength}

entries.title: Job 3:18
segments: [There] the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.

entries.title: Job 3:19
segments: The small and great are there; and the servant [is] free from his master.

entries.title: Job 3:20
segments: ¶Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter [in] soul;

words.text: to him that is in misery

entries.title: Job 3:21
segments: Which long for death, but it [cometh] not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures; {long: Heb. wait}

words.text: for it more than for hid treasures

entries.title: Job 3:22
segments: Which rejoice exceedingly, [and] are glad, when they can find the grave?

entries.title: Job 3:23
segments: [Why is light given] to a man whose way is hid, and whom God hath hedged in?

words.text: [Why is light given] to a man

entries.title: Job 3:24
segments: For my sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters. {I eat: Heb. my meat}

entries.title: Job 3:25
segments: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me. {the thing...: Heb. I feared a fear, and it came upon me}

entries.title: Job 3:26
segments: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.
